# Legacy .NET Modernization

Prefer incremental modernization.

Assess:
- Target framework.
- Package compatibility.
- System.Web dependencies.
- App.config/web.config behavior.
- Windows-only APIs.
- Serialization.
- Authentication.
- Data access.
- Third-party UI/control dependencies.

Create a migration sequence that keeps the application deployable after each stage.
